content: Oban queue concurrency across all queues competes with the app's own Ecto pool for the same Postgres connections; sizing concurrency too high relative to pool_size/DB max_connections causes pool checkout timeouts and, under sustained load, a retry-driven death spiral. Rule of thumb: keep total pool usage (web + Oban) well under Postgres max_connections, especially critical on a single small VPS Postgres instance.
